es: Informar al grupo en un minuto con titular, avance y petición, y dejar por escrito un resumen de acciones con responsable y fecha.

vocabulary.es: con retraso, por detrás de lo previsto

teaching.en: Headline: we have collected 240 kilos of food, and we need three more volunteers to sort it before the vans leave on Friday.
teaching.es: Titular: hemos recogido 240 kilos de comida y necesitamos tres voluntarios más para clasificarla antes de que las furgonetas salgan el viernes.
teaching.explanationEs: En una exposición oral el titular abre y la petición cierra la idea. Sort es clasificar.

teaching.en: We continue to make progress: every donation so far has been sorted, except the drinks, which are still behind schedule.
teaching.es: Seguimos avanzando: todas las donaciones recibidas hasta ahora se han clasificado, salvo las bebidas, que siguen con retraso.
teaching.explanationEs: El avance informa del estado sin contar toda la historia. Behind schedule señala un retraso frente a lo previsto.

teaching.en: Sara is responsible for the vans, and she has promised to take ownership of the whole route, so Tom only has to deliver the boxes.
teaching.es: Sara es responsable de las furgonetas y ha prometido hacerse cargo de toda la ruta, así que Tom solo tiene que entregar las cajas.
teaching.explanationEs: Cada tarea lleva un nombre: responsible for + cosa; take ownership of + tarea; deliver + objeto.

teaching.en: To recap: the boxes are ready, the vans leave at nine to deliver them, and we only need three people to help us tie up loose ends on Saturday.
teaching.es: Para resumir: las cajas están listas, las furgonetas salen a las nueve para entregarlas y solo necesitamos tres personas que nos ayuden a atar cabos sueltos el sábado.
teaching.explanationEs: To recap anuncia el cierre de una exposición oral; tie up loose ends es rematar los últimos pendientes.

teaching.explanationEs: En un resumen escrito, cada acción lleva quién, qué y para cuándo. Follow through on es cumplir lo prometido.

prompt.es: Elige la apertura oral que da primero el titular de la colecta.

choices.text: Headline: we have collected 180 kilos of food, and we need two drivers for Saturday.
First, some background: the collection began eight years ago, and two drivers are missing this year.
Quick update: the old route is no longer in use, and we have collected 180 kilos so far.

feedback.es: La buena apertura dice ya lo esencial, resultado y necesidad; la que empieza por el pasado retrasa la petición, y la que da una novedad sobre la ruta no es la petición.

hint.es: El titular va primero: resultado y necesidad.

origin.text: You have one minute to brief the class on the collection: 180 kilos so far, two drivers still missing for Saturday, and the old route no longer matters.

prompt.es: Completa: «Para resumir: las cajas están listas y las furgonetas salen a las nueve.»

feedback.es: To recap es la señal para cerrar y resumir; resume en inglés significa reanudar, no resumir.

hint.es: Es un verbo de cinco letras que anuncia el cierre.

origin.text: Sara will call the school on Monday. To ___: the boxes are ready and the vans leave at nine.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Leo es responsable de las bebidas.»

answer.text: Leo is responsible for the drinks

feedback.es: Responsible se construye con for, no con of, y después viene lo que cuidas.

prompt.es: Escucha la novedad y elige qué acción tiene Mia.

choices.text: The school will call Mia on Monday.
Mia will phone the school by Monday.
Mia will sort the drinks on Monday.

feedback.es: La acción tiene responsable (Mia), verbo (calls the school) y plazo (by Monday); Tom entrega las llaves, no Mia.

origin.audio: Quick update: we have sorted most of the donations, though the drinks are still behind schedule. Next action: Mia calls the school by Monday, and Tom hands the keys to Sara on Friday.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada expresión del informe con su significado.

feedback.es: Son las piezas que describen cómo va una tarea: avance, retraso, cumplimiento y responsabilidad.

prompt.es: Completa: «Mia prometió entregar las donaciones el lunes y lo cumplirá aunque llueva.»

feedback.es: Follow through on es la colocación para cumplir lo prometido hasta el final.

origin.text: Mia promised to deliver the donations on Monday, and she will ___ through on it even if it rains.

prompt.es: Expón al grupo: titular, avance, petición y acciones, y cierra con un resumen.

answer.text: Headline: we have collected 240 kilos of food for the charity, and we need three more volunteers to sort it on Thursday at four. Progress is good: everything has been sorted except the drinks, which are a little behind schedule. Here is my request: could three people join us? Please reply no later than Wednesday; otherwise, we will ask another class. Sara is responsible for the vans, and Tom will deliver the boxes on Friday. To recap, the next actions are these: Sara will call the school by Monday, and I will draw up the final list on Saturday. I know this is a lot to ask on short notice, but every extra pair of hands makes the work lighter. Thank you all for your help, and please get back to me if anything changes.

To recap, the next actions are these: Sara will call the school by Monday, and I will draw up the final list on Saturday. I know this is a lot to ask on short notice, but every extra pair of hands makes the work lighter. Thank you all for your help, and please get back to me if anything changes.

Quick update: we collected 240 kilos of food for the charity, and we still need three volunteers to sort it on Thursday at four. We are making good progress, and only the drinks are behind schedule. My request is simple: please tell me by Wednesday if you can come; otherwise, we will ask another class for help. Sara is responsible for the vans, and Tom delivers the boxes on Friday. To recap, the actions are these: Sara calls the school by Monday, and I will draw up the final list on Saturday. I know it is a lot to ask, but every extra pair of hands helps. Thanks a lot, and get back to me if any date is a problem for you.

Headline: we have collected 240 kilos of food, and we need three more people to sort it on Thursday at four. The progress so far is good, although the drinks are still behind schedule and nobody has taken ownership of them. Could three volunteers come? Please answer before Wednesday; otherwise, I will ask another class. Sara is responsible for the vans, Tom will deliver the boxes on Friday, and Sara will call the school by Monday. To recap: we need volunteers, answers and deliveries. I will draw up the final list on Saturday and send it to you. I know it is a lot to ask on short notice, but every extra pair of hands helps. Thank you all, and please follow through on your tasks.

feedback.es: La exposición sigue titular, avance, petición con plazo y acciones con responsable, y cierra con To recap.

origin.text: Colecta solidaria del colegio: has recogido 240 kilos de comida y vas bien (solo las bebidas van con retraso), pero faltan tres voluntarios para clasificarla el jueves a las cuatro. Pides respuesta antes del miércoles; si no, preguntarás a otra clase. Sara es responsable de las furgonetas, Tom entrega las cajas el viernes y Sara llama al colegio antes del lunes. Tú redactarás la lista definitiva el sábado. Cierra con un resumen.

prompt.es: Lee el mensaje y elige su titular.

choices.text: Two vans are still behind schedule.
Sara is responsible for the route.
We need four drivers on Saturday at nine.

feedback.es: El titular es la petición principal (cuatro conductores el sábado); los retrasos y la ruta son información de apoyo.

origin.text: Hi team. The school hall was full of boxes yesterday, and the smell of pizza came from the next room, which confused a few volunteers. The main point is that we need four drivers on Saturday at nine, because two vans are still behind schedule. Please reply no later than Friday noon; otherwise, I will ask the parents. Sara is responsible for the route, and I will draw up the final list on Friday evening.

prompt.es: Según el mensaje, ¿qué da a entender el autor con «otherwise, I will ask the parents»?

choices.text: That the writer would rather hear from the volunteers than involve the parents.
That the parents have already refused to help.
That he will cancel the collection without replies.

feedback.es: Pedir ayuda a los padres es su plan B: sugiere que preferiría contar con los voluntarios, pero no que los padres se hayan negado ni que vaya a cancelar la colecta.

origin.text: Hi team. The school hall was full of boxes yesterday, and the smell of pizza came from the next room, which confused a few volunteers. The main point is that we need four drivers on Saturday at nine, because two vans are still behind schedule. Please reply no later than Friday noon; otherwise, I will ask the parents. Sara is responsible for the route, and I will draw up the final list on Friday evening.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Para resumir, Sara llamará al colegio antes del lunes.»

answer.text: To recap, Sara will call the school by Monday

feedback.es: To recap abre el cierre oral y cada acción lleva responsable, verbo y plazo.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué espera el hablante de los oyentes.

choices.text: That everyone stays after noon to tie up loose ends.
That a volunteer takes the spare boxes to the school.
That someone brings extra boxes from the school at noon.

feedback.es: It would be great if someone could… es una petición implícita; el final a mediodía y la ayuda posterior son solo información.

origin.audio: It would be great if someone could take the extra boxes to the school, although I'm not going to chase anyone. Anyway, the upshot is that we finish at noon, and anyone who is free after that is welcome to help us tie up loose ends.

prompt.es: ¿Qué resumen escrito nombra acciones, responsables y fechas?

choices.text: Recap: Sara will call the school soon; Tom delivers the boxes at some point; Mia sends the list later.
Recap: the school, the boxes and the list are important, and everybody should help where they can.
Recap: Sara calls the school by Monday; Tom delivers the boxes by Friday; Mia sends the list on Saturday.

feedback.es: Un buen resumen de acciones indica quién hace qué y para cuándo; los otros dejan las fechas en el aire o no nombran responsables.

prompt.es: Redacta para el grupo el resumen escrito de las tres acciones.

answer.text: Recap of actions: Sara will call the school by Monday. Tom will deliver the boxes on Friday. Mia will draw up the final list by Saturday. Please reply if any date is a problem for you.
accepted: Recap of actions: Sara will call the school by Monday. Tom will deliver the boxes on Friday. Mia will draw up the final list by Saturday. Please reply if any date is a problem for you.
To recap: Sara calls the school by Monday, Tom delivers the boxes on Friday, and Mia will draw up the final list by Saturday. Tell me if a date does not work for you.

feedback.es: El resumen escrito da a cada acción un responsable, un verbo y una fecha.

origin.text: Acciones: Sara llama al colegio antes del lunes; Tom entrega las cajas el viernes; Mia redacta la lista definitiva antes del sábado. Pide que avisen si alguna fecha es un problema.
